762.headline: How much has sold

827.body:
Most of the tickets for "50th Anniversary" have been sold. The game is near the end of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Tomorrow's count on "50th Anniversary" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
827.headline: Early stage or late

847.body:
Before you buy "Bingo 50X", know that its $500,000 top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $100,000. That is still a sizable prize, but much smaller than the one shown on the ticket.

If "Bingo 50X" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
